sections.heading: Assembly Instructions
steps: First, place the bench grinder on a strong, stable workbench. Ensure the surface is clean and all tools are ready.
Next, fix the grinder to the bench using bolts and nuts. Tighten them securely to prevent vibration during operation.
Then, install the grinding wheels on both sides of the machine and tighten the locking nuts properly.
After that, attach the tool rests and spark guards, and adjust them to the correct position close to the wheels. This will prevent injury.
Before the final step, connect the power cable and check that the switch is in the off position.
Finally, switch on the grinder and test it without load to ensure smooth and balanced rotation.

sections.heading: Maintenance Tips
steps: Clean the grinder regularly to remove dust and metal particles.
Check the grinding wheels for cracks or wear before use.
Adjust tool rests and guards as needed to maintain safety.
Lubricate moving parts if required according to the manual.

sections.heading: Safety Measures
steps: Always wear safety goggles and protective gloves.
Keep hands away from the rotating grinding wheels.
Do not use damaged or cracked grinding wheels.
Switch off the machine before making adjustments or cleaning.

sections.heading: Assembly Instructions
steps: First, place the printer on a stable, flat surface near a power source. Ensure the area is clean and well ventilated.
Next, remove all packing materials from the printer and open the covers carefully to check inside.
Then, install the toner cartridge (which has the ink) into the printer and lock it securely in position.
After that, load paper into the input tray and adjust the paper guides properly.
Before the final step, connect the power cable and data cable (USB or network), and switch on the printer.
Finally, install the printer drivers on the computer and print a test page to ensure proper operation.

sections.heading: Maintenance Tips
steps: Clean the exterior and paper trays regularly to remove dust.
Check toner levels and replace cartridges when necessary.
Remove paper jams carefully to avoid damage.
Update printer drivers and software when required.

sections.heading: Safety Measures
steps: Do not touch internal parts when the printer is operating.
Always switch off the printer before cleaning or maintenance.
Keep liquids away from the printer to avoid damage.
Use the correct power supply and avoid overloading sockets.
